bullets.text: Operating income reached a record $485.5M; underwriting margin of 4.8% aligned with the 4% underwriting profit goal; Personal Lines GAAP CR was 95.5; return on average shareholders' equity was 13.5% (five-year average 12.6%).
The first market cycle phase appears to be playing out as expected; reporting stronger growth rates by year end, Progressive feels prepared for the cycle's second phase of profitable growth.
Personal Lines earned premium increased 11% to $6.5B; Direct earned premium rose 46% to $1.8B; Agent earned premium rose 1% to $4.7B; Progressive reported stronger growth rates by year end.

In the first full year under dedicated channel structures, Agent posted a 94.7 CR with profit in nine of ten top states; Direct CR improved 12.8 points to 97.7, with calendar-year profitability expected.

Personal Lines auto PIF rose 4%; Direct auto PIF grew 18%; Agent auto PIF declined 1%; customer retention initiatives expanded through probing cancellation reasons and measuring retention impacts of alternative claims handling solutions.

Demanded rate adequacy across every market and product to restore margin, accepting lower unit growth; business model requires each channel and product to meet distinct profitability targets blending to 4% underwriting profit.

Investment portfolio reached $8.2B, aided by $350M debt issuance; 84% fixed income, 16% common stock; 5.9% fully-taxable equivalent total return; 932,234 shares repurchased; policies set debt at 20%–30% of total capital.

June Tropical Storm Allison in Texas produced company's largest catastrophe loss ever; sent nearly 4,100 proactive claim-alert emails and paid over 6,000 claims, settling almost 50% in three weeks and 90% in 50 days.

Testing end-to-end claims service with over 10,000 consumers; offers courtesy car, repair oversight, repair guarantee for vehicle ownership duration, taking under 20 minutes plus drive time; expansion planned upon meeting prototype criteria.

Added Customer Value Proposition ('FAST, FAIR, BETTER'); aims to maintain an almost fanatical focus on auto insurance, systematically eliminating non-core businesses; began monthly underwriting reporting in May and published a claim reserves report in June.
